blockers.title: required exact-head workflow references source that does not exist
blockers.required_change: converge the workflow to tracked source and add a path-inventory gate; future crates enter the matrix only in the commit that creates and wires them
acceptance: all workflow-owned paths exist at exact head
source job executes non-empty steps
Rust jobs execute fmt/check/test/clippy for existing owned crates
aggregate fails for skipped/cancelled/failure and passes only after all required source jobs pass

blockers.title: current plan and machine status describe stale repository and source facts
blockers.required_change: add V3/V4 current truth files while keeping historical receipts immutable
acceptance: current files point to the present repository and PR stack
source-present and real-executed claims are separated
one ledger enumerates every open blocker and evidence dependency

blockers.title: same-user public UDS peers can publish worker events and operator restart
blockers.required_change: separate public client, worker and operator authority; public dispatch rejects Start, Token, Complete and RestartBackend
acceptance: same-UID public peer cannot forge start/token/complete
same-UID public peer cannot restart or drain backend
role violation returns a stable typed error
worker/operator channel requires a daemon-minted capability or inherited private handle
blockers.evidence_type: negative unit and daemon E2E tests

blockers.title: queue-only limits allow unbounded inflight and running records
blockers.required_change: add global/per-tenant inflight and running accounting with deterministic release on completion, cancellation and restart
acceptance: admit-start loops cannot bypass quotas
global and tenant running limits reject before transition
all terminal paths release reservations exactly once
snapshot accounting equals retained records in fault tests

blockers.title: token digests are discarded and completion digest/count are caller assertions
blockers.required_change: maintain a domain-separated rolling token digest, accepted token count/bytes and output-token limit
acceptance: completion count equals accepted token count
completion digest equals the controller-computed chain
output token limit is enforced at token acceptance
forged digest, count drift and sequence drift fail closed

blockers.title: daemon connections and frame I/O are not concurrency or time bounded
blockers.required_change: add connection semaphore and bounded read/write/idle timeouts
acceptance: partial-frame peers release permits after timeout
connection count never exceeds configured maximum
one slow peer cannot block daemon progress
timeouts remain connection-local

blockers.title: terminal receipts are not recovered after daemon restart and have no disk budget
blockers.required_change: implement atomic journal writes, startup scan/index, bounded files/bytes/TTL and memory release after durable persistence
acceptance: old-generation terminal receipt is queryable after restart
corrupt, duplicate and oversized receipts fail closed
terminal controller memory remains bounded
parent directory durability is synchronized where supported

blockers.title: adapter contracts are not connected to a real provider call behind hepta-inferd
dependencies: fixed pre-installed local provider and model tuple
blockers.required_change: execute one fixed Ollama or LM Studio tuple through daemon with bounded semantic output and inventory fences
acceptance: real provider process executes
real model returns semantic output
pre/post model inventory is identical
no implicit install, model switch, proxy, redirect or remote fallback

blockers.title: native worker source is a state-machine contract, not an isolated model process
dependencies: pinned llama.cpp build and fixed GGUF artifact
blockers.required_change: create the minimal isolated worker host and call the pinned native runtime ABI for a real model
acceptance: one fixed GGUF loads on one real device
at least one real UTF-8 token is emitted
model/tokenizer/template/runtime/SBOM/license/device digests are bound
crash/OOM/protocol-violation paths increment generation and do not fall back remotely

blockers.title: running cancellation has no backend acknowledgement or forced-kill execution proof
blockers.required_change: implement CancelRequested, worker CancelAck, bounded timeout, forced process termination and generation rollover
acceptance: normal cancellation receipt requires worker acknowledgement
timeout kills the worker and marks forced_worker_termination=true
late tokens from the old session/generation are rejected
transport disconnect is never classified as backend acknowledgement

blockers.title: scheduler, reservation ledger and tenant-scoped KV/prefix cache are absent
blockers.required_change: implement EDF/WFQ and reservation recovery before adding generation-scoped tenant/workspace cache
acceptance: fairness and starvation bounds
cache cannot cross tenant/workspace/policy/tuple/generation
cancellation under load releases every lease
OOM/thermal/backpressure breaker is fail closed

blockers.title: new control plane is not wired into a product shadow route
blockers.required_change: wire an unprivileged SHADOW_COMPARE_ONLY product bridge without changing primary route or granting Memory/KG/effect authority
acceptance: product caller cannot publish worker events
primary output remains authoritative during shadow
shadow output is a typed proposal/signal only
kill switch and rollback preserve the original route

blockers.title: exact-device performance, independent acceptance, promotion and release evidence are absent
blockers.required_change: run per-device functional/performance/privacy/rollback qualification and obtain independent operator acceptance
acceptance: each device/driver/runtime/model tuple has its own receipt
cold/warm TTFT, throughput, peak RSS/VRAM, cancel latency and unload recovery are measured
operator acceptance is explicit and independent
promotion and release occur only in separate authorized commits
blockers.evidence_type: target-device receipts plus operator acceptance record
